data.name: remoteClientIPInfoHelp.Text
data.value:
This form collects network information for the remote clients managed in STCM.
The Start and End IP device IDs are the last octet in the IP range. Ex: 192.168.56.101 - 192.168.56.201 (101 is the last octet in the beginning of the range, and 201 is the last octet in the ending range).
The prefix are the first 3 octets (192.168.56), which is the class C address.
